title: Training records (CSV export from the LMS and a roster)
readScopes: CSV export from the LMS (no API access)

checks.title: Everyone on the roster completed security awareness training within 12 months
checks.scope: People on the roster the customer supplies; completeness of the roster is the customer's.

checks.title: People in privileged roles completed role-based training within 12 months
checks.scope: Roster people whose role is in the privileged list; which roles count is the customer's choice.

checks.title: Every person on the roster has a training record
checks.scope: Training rows matched to the roster by person_id; rows for people not on the roster are counted only.
